witness.description: Finite instance exercising the exact rational verifier of L1: exact cross-multiplied integer comparison decides subset-sum distinctness; no floats, no imports, no I/O. Witness is embedded and passed to verify(witness), which RAISES on any failed check. No exception = PASS.

abort_control.reason: N = 0 outside contract scope (N != 0 required); verifier must fail closed, not silently pass

claim: verify(WITNESS) returning without exception establishes the finite-scope content of L1: the verifier decides subset-sum distinctness by exact cross-multiplied integer comparison, is deterministic and float-free, accepts a genuinely distinct instance, rejects a colliding one, and fails closed (raises) on the out-of-scope N = 0 case — the fail-closed/deterministic/float-free properties of L1 demonstrated on a finite instance with no imports, no I/O, and no environment dependence.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
